Pickleball Programming at Rec Centers

Alamo Recreation Center
2100 Alamo St.,

  • Covered Outdoor Basketball Pavilion. Temporary court markers available.
  • Open play: Thursday, 4 p.m. to 8 p.m.

Dottie Jordan Recreation Center
2803 Loyola Lane,

  • 2 Outdoor Tennis Courts. Nets, paddles, and balls available for checkout at the Dottie Jordan Recreation Center.
  • Open Play: Thursday, 4 p.m. to 7 p.m.
  • Equipment Rental available until 6 p.m.

George Morales Dove Springs Recreation Center
5801 Ainez Drive,

  • 3 Indoor Courts
  • Open Play Schedule:
    • Monday: 9 a.m. - 12 p.m.
    • Wednesday: 6 p.m.- 8:30 p.m.
    • Friday: 9 a.m. - 12 p.m.

Gus Garcia Recreation Center
1201 E. Rundberg Ln.,

  • 1 Multi-purpose Indoor Courts with striping for 3 pickleball courts
  • Open Play
    • Tuesday 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.
    • Thursday 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.
    • Saturday 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.
    • Sunday 1:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m.

Montopolis Recreation and Community Center
1200 Montopolis Dr.,

  • 1 Multi-purpose Indoor Courts with striping for 2 pickleball courts
  • Open Play: Monday, 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. and Saturday, 10 a.m. to 12 p.m.

Northwest Recreation Center
2913 Northland Dr.,

  • 1 Multi-purpose Indoor Courts with striping for 3 pickleball courts
  • Open Play: Monday and Wednesday, 10:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m.
